name: yarbrain
description: Lessons that coding agents record, an independent gate agent trusts, and later sessions reuse.

interface.shortDescription: Lessons agents record and an independent gate trusts
interface.longDescription: Record what a session taught as small Markdown lessons, have a fresh-context gate agent trust or reject them against the committed code, and find, confirm, or doubt them in later sessions.
defaultPrompt: Set up Yarbrain with a vault at a path I choose.
Find Yarbrain lessons that apply to this task.
Record what this session taught us as a Yarbrain lesson.
